name: Bezaleel
overview: Bezaleel, called by name by the Lord, was divinely endowed with the Spirit of God granting him wisdom, understanding, knowledge, and skill in all kinds of craftsmanship. He was appointed as a master workman to design and execute intricate works in gold, silver, brass, stone cutting, and wood carving for the tabernacle. Furthermore, God placed in his heart the ability to teach others, including Aholiab, enabling them to perform skilled embroidery, weaving, and engraving necessary for the sacred work. Bezaleel’s unique gifting and leadership highlight God’s sovereign provision of gifted individuals to fulfill His holy purposes.
